title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Handle CSV (comma-separated values) files
summary: This blog series covers multiple techniques for working with comma-separated values (CSV) files in Dynamics 365 Business Central, including importing and exporting data via AL code and Power Automate, importing bulk large text fields, previewing multiple file types, and using Copilot to suggest sales lines from CSV files.
key_points: CSV files can be imported to and exported from Business Central tables using AL code or Power Automate without customization
Power Automate enables JSON to CSV conversion for exporting and CSV to JSON conversion for importing data
Large text fields exceeding 250 or 2048 characters can be bulk imported from external files via AL
Multiple file types including CSV can be previewed within Business Central from SharePoint
Copilot in Business Central 2024 wave 2 can suggest sales lines directly from CSV files
